test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: An article is sold at a profit of 13(1)/(4)\%. Had it been sold for ₹76.70 more, the profit would have been 16(1)/(5)\%. The cost price of the article is:
solution:
**Given:**

An article is sold at a profit of 13(1)/(4)\%

Had it been sold for ₹76.70 more, the profit would have been 16(1)/(5)\%

**Concept used:**

SP = CP + Profit

**Calculation:**

Let the CP be 100x.

So, SP = 113.25x [13(1)/(4)\% = 13.25%]

New, SP = 116.2x [16(1)/(5)\% = 16.2%]

According to the question,

116.2x - 113.25x = 76.7

⇒ 2.95x = 76.7

⇒ x = 76.7/2.95 = 26

So CP = 100 × 26

⇒ Rs. 2600

**∴ Cost price is Rs. 2600**
